zh-CN.title: 鹿野苑（Sarnath）
zh-CN.subtitle: 初转法轮传统与后世佛教朝圣遗址
zh-CN.shortSummary: 鹿野苑把释迦牟尼、初转法轮、早期僧团记忆和后世朝圣连接到一个真实的考古地点。
curatorialDescription: 现实地图显示的是鹿野苑考古遗址的地理参照；‘佛陀在此初转法轮’属于经文、传统与遗产记忆共同构成的历史层。
地点条目不把遗址的现存建筑直接当作公元前现场原貌，而把教法传述、遗址遗存和现代保护分开呈现。
zh-CN.researchNote: 坐标为遗址级示意点；初转法轮的叙事来自早期佛教文本与后世遗产记忆，遗址建筑和朝圣史仍需继续分期。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 早期佛教传统至公元 12 世纪遗址发展；现代保护延续

en.title: Sarnath
en.subtitle: A first-teaching tradition and later Buddhist pilgrimage site
en.shortSummary: Sarnath connects Śākyamuni, the first-turning-of-the-Dharma tradition, early monastic memory and later Buddhist pilgrimage to a real archaeological place.
curatorialDescription: The real map shows a geographic reference for the archaeological site; the claim that the Buddha first taught here belongs to a layered history of texts, tradition and heritage memory.
The place record does not treat surviving monuments as a literal scene from the fifth century BCE. Teaching tradition, archaeological remains and modern conservation remain separate layers.
en.researchNote: The coordinate is a site-level schematic point. The first-teaching narrative comes from early Buddhist texts and later heritage memory; architectural phases and pilgrimage history still require periodisation.
en.timeLabel: Early Buddhist tradition through the site's first-millennium development; modern conservation continues
